name: Naspro 2006
question: How do holmium laser enucleation and open prostatectomy compare for obstructive symptoms in men with prostates over 70 g?

arms.label: Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate

design.population: Eighty consecutive men with benign prostatic hyperplasia-related obstructed voiding symptoms and prostates over 70 g were randomized.

verdictNote: Open surgery was faster; HoLEP shortened catheterization and hospitalization, with comparable functional findings at 24 months.
takeaway: In 80 men with prostates over 70 g, HoLEP versus open prostatectomy had comparable urodynamic and uroflowmetry findings at 24 months. Open surgery took less operating-room time; HoLEP shortened catheterization and hospitalization and reduced blood loss and transfusions.

reports.label: 24-month report
reports.citation: Naspro R, Suardi N, Salonia A, et al. "Holmium laser enucleation of the prostate versus open prostatectomy for prostates >70 g: 24-month follow-up." *Eur Urol.* 2006;50(3):563-568. doi:10.1016/j.eururo.2006.04.003

values.exp: Improved from baseline; comparable with open prostatectomy
values.ctl: Improved from baseline; comparable with HoLEP

results.note: The abstract does not identify a prespecified primary endpoint or give arm-specific functional estimates.

values.exp: Less blood loss and fewer transfusions
